model: english XGB multi:softprob, Optuna-tuned per (backbone, method); trained on EN train+val; targets EN (in-language) and IT (cross-lingual)

tuning_protocol.objective: EN-val (140) OVR-macro AUC (sklearn roc_auc_score multi_class=ovr, average=macro); fallback to single-label macro-F1 only if AUC is non-finite
tuning_protocol.final_fit: best params retrained on EN train+val (416); evaluated EN test + IT test with the 0.00..1.00 threshold sweep

method_definitions.pc: iterative GLOBAL PC ablation k=2, fit on the stacked-language TRAIN pool (pc_ablation_flores.pc_ablation_dirs / apply_dirs), per backbone
method_definitions.inlp: project out the backbone-matched FLORES language-subspace basis (210m=lang_inlp_agg.npz 3 dirs; 610m=lang_inlp_agg_610.npz)
method_definitions.pc+inlp: pc (k=2) then project out the inlp subspace
method_definitions.l2_thenZ: L2-normalize then per-language TRAIN z-score (stats from that language's own train_idx rows)

note: At each t, class c is positive iff p_c >= t; micro P/R/F1 pooled over all (document, class) pairs. 'en' = EN model -> English test (in-language); 'it' = EN model -> Italian test (cross-lingual). Gap = EN peak F1 minus IT peak F1 at each language's own F1-optimal threshold.
